title: NP-hardness from Max-Cut promise separation
statement: Let $\pi/2<\theta<\pi$, assume the Unique Games Conjecture, and let $L$ be a language of binary strings. If $L$ contains every encoded nonempty edge list whose associated Max-Cut optimum is at least $(1-\cos\theta)/2$, and is disjoint from the encoded nonempty edge lists whose optimum is less than $\theta/\pi$, then $L$ is NP-hard under polynomial-time many-one reductions.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ contains the Max-Cut yes-language at threshold $(1-\cos\theta)/2$.
$L$ is disjoint from the Max-Cut no-language at threshold $\theta/\pi$.
